description: This is a Java interface defining the ProductRepository, which extends JpaRepository for performing database operations related to the Product entity, specifically for persistence in a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Product entities, providing methods to find products by merchant store ID and SKU, and to retrieve paginated lists of products.

methods.name: findByMerchantStoreIdAndSku
methods.description: Finds a product by merchant store ID and SKU, returning an Optional<Product>.

methods.name: findByMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products for a given merchant store ID.
